verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs describe a built-in AI palette (cmd+j on highlighted text) with about a dozen prompts such as 'list key takeaways' and 'list action-items', plus an open text field and saved custom prompts for drafting. You can also apply search filters (tags, dates, backlinks, daily notes, pinned) and then 'chat' with exactly those notes, which scopes what the AI sees, and you can choose between GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Items 61-66 (open-source, local Markdown, bring-your-own key, private notes excluded) may describe a different product, so they are not relied on. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the data-exposure policy for AI (what leaves the encrypted vault and goes to the model providers), documented source-citation of answers, independent or hands-on corroboration of AI answer quality.
